rationale: The prompt presupposes a single workspace-admin named Robert, but the admin-role filter genuinely narrows the pool to three people (Robert Walsh, Morgan Freeman, Robert Kim), and the name filter further narrows to two disjoint admins (Walsh and the newly mutated Robert Kim), producing a real unresolved referent under 'underspecified' mode without delegated authority. The seed mutation (Robert Kim: new user, admin user_teams row, two channel_members rows) is an actual environment change that creates a genuine second matching admin rather than merely relisting an old negative, and all pre-existing intended referents (Robert Walsh's admin status/memberships, Robert Chen's member status, Hubert's and Morgan Freeman's records) remain unchanged. Both selectors correctly traverse the assigned route CONVERSATION_MEMBERSHIP→USER→WORKSPACE_MEMBERSHIP (channel_members→users→user_teams for obligation 1, user_teams→users for obligation 2), applying both the name-contains and role-eq filters jointly so Robert Chen (name match, wrong role) and Morgan Freeman (role match, wrong name) are correctly excluded from the answer while remaining useful path-derived negatives. Answer-computation attributes are bare table.column names (channel_members.channel_id/user_id, user_teams.role), and no unsupported API capability (e.g., joined_at duration) is requested in this revision, unlike the prior draft. Access via users.list/users.info and users.conversations/channel_members is realistic given the acting agent's membership and the documented API's exposed fields. No mechanical errors were found and none are apparent on independent review.
